The candidate is not expected to code on a daily basis, but must be technically strong enough to understand, evaluate, and challenge engineering decisions.

Strong understanding of:

  • Modern software development lifecycle and engineering practices
  • Web and enterprise application architecture
  • APIs, microservices, system integrations, and databases
  • Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • DevOps, CI/CD, Git, containerization, and deployment processes

  • Minimum 5 years in Technical Project Management, Program Management, Delivery Management, or similar leadership roles.

  • Experience delivering medium-to-large projects for external/enterprise clients.
  • Strong understanding of estimation, resource planning, project financials, utilization, and delivery margins.
  • Experience delivering AI/ML or GenAI-based projects will be a plus.
  • Experience working with international clients, particularly North American, European, or Middle Eastern customers, is advantageous.

  • PMP/PRINCE2, Scrum/SAFe, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, or similar certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.

Success Measures

Success will be measured through on-time and within-budget delivery across projects, project quality, client satisfaction, resource utilization, estimation accuracy, delivery margins, risk management, reduced escalations, team performance, and repeat business/account growth.

Ideal Candidate

A technically grounded program and delivery leader who can comfortably move between multiple project priorities, client discussions, architecture reviews, sprint/release planning, resource challenges, commercial concerns, and escalations.

The ideal candidate should be able to ask engineering teams the right technical questions, communicate complex issues to clients in business language, make practical delivery decisions, and take clear ownership of overall program and delivery outcomes.

plus)

appropriate

Database Engineering

Cassandra) schemas
● Lead database performance optimisation: query tuning, indexing strategies, execution plan analysis,
and caching layers
● Define data security controls: encryption at rest and in transit, field-level masking, RBAC, and audit
logging
● Govern data lifecycle policies, backup/recovery strategies, and disaster recovery testing
● Evaluate and introduce new storage technologies aligned to specific workload demands

DevOps & Developer Experience

● Champion CI/CD pipeline design, branching strategies, and automated testing gates
● Containerise applications using Docker and oversee Kubernetes / ECS / Cloud Run deployment models
● Promote shift-left security (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning) within the development workflow
● Establish SLOs, error budgets, and observability practices using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana,
Datadog, or equivalent

products

architect capacity

● Solid grasp of OOP, functional programming, design patterns (SOLID, DDD, CQRS, Event Sourcing), and
clean code principles

(Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS)
● Proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed systems in production environments

[AWS] [Azure] [Google Cloud Platform]

storage, CDN, VPC/networking

Vault)
● Experience with cloud cost management, tagging strategies, and rightsizing

(Flyway, Liquibase)
● Performance tuning: EXPLAIN/ANALYZE, index design, covering indexes, partitioning, connection
pooling

● Database security: row-level security, column masking, audit trails, encryption key management
● High-availability configurations: read replicas, failover clusters, cross-region replication
